tex_content.html:
Proposition
1. ch4:4.5

↗ lem:connection-is-local-operator

For a connection, $ abla _XY|_p$ depends only on the germ of $Y$ near $p$ and the single value $X_p$.
Proof

\sketch Locality handles $Y$. If $X_p=0$, restrict to coordinates and write $X=X^i\partial _i$ with $X^i(p)=0$; restriction to the coordinate neighborhood and $C^\infty $-linearity give $ abla _XY|_p=X^i(p) abla _{\partial _i}Y|_p=0$.

□

Thus for $v\in T_pM$ and a local section $Y$, define $ abla _vY$ by extending $v$ to a local field $X$ and setting $ abla _vY= abla _XY|_p$; the preceding proposition makes this well defined.
